description: Capacity and partition contract for the profiler v2 corpus. Counts are release gates, not generated filler.

buckets.purpose: Preserve the checked-in 1.1.1 characterization bank without relabeling it as new ground truth.
Equivalent intent expressed without dictionary phrases, including synonym and paraphrase pairs.
Negation, quoted keywords, non-operative mentions, adversarial wording, and near-boundary cases.
Italian, code-switching, typos, abbreviations, colloquial language, and lexical noise.
Multiple task families, contradictory preferences, and risk signals mixed with cheap or brief requests.
Files, code blocks, images, lists, long context, and tasks whose evidence is primarily structural.

rules: No tuning against held-out prompts or their distinctive vocabulary.
Dictionary and rule authors may see aggregate metrics, not case text, before freeze.
Cases move into specification only after policy freeze and adjudication.
